The draft covers representative frame preparation, subassembly checks and final bicycle assembly.<Location LocationID="20" SetupHours="0.3" LaborHours="1.5" MachineHours="0.8" LotSize="1">Work Center 20 - Frame Welding. The exact joint geometry is not supplied.</step><step>Keep 1 EA <material>HL Fork (Product Number FK-9939)</material> with the frame set for later fitting; do not weld it to the frame.</step></Location><Location LocationID="30" SetupHours="0.1" LaborHours="0.5" MachineHours="0" LotSize="1">Work Center 30 - Debur and Polish. Demonstrate application with an assumed <tool>paint station</tool>; no application or curing settings are specified.</step><step>After the finish is ready for handling, place 2 EA <material>Decal 1 (Product Number DC-8732)</material> and 1 EA <material>Decal 2 (Product Number DC-9824)</material> on the frame as a demo assumption, and visually check the finish.</step></Location><Location LocationID="50" SetupHours="0.15" LaborHours="1" MachineHours="0" LotSize="1">Work Center 50 - Subassembly. Fit and visually check the parts using assumed <tool>hand tools</tool>; exact fastener positions are not supplied.</step><step>Stage and visually inspect 1 EA <material>HL Road Front Wheel (Product Number FW-R820)</material> and 1 EA <material>HL Road Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-R820)</material> as completed wheel subassemblies.</step><step>Stage and visually inspect 1 EA <material>ML Headset (Product Number HS-2451)</material>, 1 EA <material>HL Bottom Bracket (Product Number BB-9108)</material> and 1 EA <material>HL Road Handlebars (Product Number HB-R956)</material> as completed subassemblies.</step></Location><Location LocationID="60" SetupHours="0.2" LaborHours="2" MachineHours="0" LotSize="1">Work Center 60 - Final Assembly. Final assembly, the center recorded in the representative product's historical routing; the detailed operations are inferred.<step>Secure 1 EA <material>HL Road Frame - Red, 44 (Product Number FR-R92R-44)</material> in an assumed <tool>assembly stand</tool>. Fit its fork with 1 EA <material>ML Headset (Product Number HS-2451)</material> and install 1 EA <material>HL Road Handlebars (Product Number HB-R956)</material>. See overview <diag>100261</diag>.</step><step>Fit 1 EA <material>HL Road Seat Assembly (Product Number SA-R522)</material> to the frame, then fit 1 EA <material>HL Road Front Wheel (Product Number FW-R820)</material> at the front and 1 EA <material>HL Road Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-R820)</material> at the rear.</step><step>Fit 1 EA <material>HL Bottom Bracket (Product Number BB-9108)</material> and 1 EA <material>ML Crankset (Product Number CS-6583)</material> to the frame. processNotes: All tooling, process choices, routing sequences and times are inferred demo estimates. The historical record shows location 60 for product 789 but does not establish an engineering routing.
Frame components and manufactured subassemblies are available as identified in the BOM; no unlisted internals or raw materials are assumed.
Quantities are BOM allocations. The single pedal entry is retained as 1 EA without assuming a pair or specifying its side.
variantNotes: The representative is Red, size 44, using frame 718 (FR-R92R-44). Its frame BOM lists 8 OZ of red paint.
Other red variants use their matching frames: size 48 uses 719 (FR-R92R-48), size 52 uses 720 (FR-R92R-52), and size 58 uses 706 (FR-R92R-58).

Black variants use their matching frames: size 44 uses 838 (FR-R92B-44), size 48 uses 839 (FR-R92B-48), size 52 uses 840 (FR-R92B-52), and size 58 uses 680 (FR-R92B-58). Do not substitute the representative red frame or paint; black-frame paint details are not supplied.
The supplied variant BOMs list the same front wheel 820 and rear wheel 828, and the same other direct components, each at 1 EA. Only the frame differs among the listed direct components.

100261.title: Representative bicycle assembly overview
guidance: Secure 1 EA HL Road Frame - Red, 44 (Product Number FR-R92R-44) in an assumed assembly stand. Fit its fork with 1 EA ML Headset (Product Number HS-2451) and install 1 EA HL Road Handlebars (Product Number HB-R956). See overview 100261.

Fit 1 EA HL Road Seat Assembly (Product Number SA-R522) to the frame, then fit 1 EA HL Road Front Wheel (Product Number FW-R820) at the front and 1 EA HL Road Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-R820) at the rear.
